roles.name: Approval Sender
roles.description: May send documents they review to another user for approval first (needs to be an approver at the level).

roles.name: Approver
roles.description: Acts where a flow names the user or their type. No permissions.

roles.name: Deletion Requester
roles.description: May ask for deletion of documents in scope (cannot review).

roles.name: Flow Admin
roles.description: Builds flows, document types and processes.

roles.name: Mailing List (all events)
roles.description: Emailed when documents in scope are approved, rejected or sent back for revision. Includes view so the link in the email opens.

roles.name: Mailing List (approved only)
roles.description: Emailed when documents in scope are fully approved.

roles.name: Receiving Clerk
roles.description: Confirms receipt of approved documents in scope.

roles.name: Reference Viewer
roles.description: May see reference documents attached to process steps, in scope (also needs documents.view for normal documents).

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Read-only access to documents in scope.
